column1: # Which candidate-root artefacts each consumer's unguarded reads require.
# `.github/scripts/candidate_consumption.py` reads this table and the root it
# is given, and partitions the consumers:
#   served    every declared artefact is published by the root -- the consumer
#             runs, and its reads are unguarded;
#   deferred  at least one declared artefact is absent -- the consumer takes
#             the module-level skip it already implements, and the exact
#             missing artefact is named in the skip reason.
# The partition is DERIVED FROM THE ROOT, never from the lane. The default
# protocol lanes run against the released suite pin, which publishes no
# schema-8 family, so the schema-8 consumer defers there and says so. The
# candidate lane runs `candidate_consumption.py require`, which asserts the
# deferred set is empty: a candidate that publishes a family this manager
# never reads can never be reported as qualified.
# An artefact is one published path or a family directory, which counts as
# present when the manifest publishes at least one file below it.
# Columns are TAB separated:
#   consumer  artefact[,artefact...]  note
# consumer
